title: Fer language
description: Central Sudanic language of the CAR
extract: The Fer language, also Dam Fer or Fertit, one of several languages called Kara, is a Central Sudanic language spoken by some five thousand people in the northern Central African Republic near the Sudanese and Chadian borders, in the region known as Dar Runga.
